checks: Confirm review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and identify all events since last IDT review, including any not yet documented in the summary.
Falls: count, dates, injuries, and circumstances in the window; check orthostatic symptoms and gait/balance given new diuretic and cardiac history.
ED visits and hospital admissions/readmissions in the window: reasons, dates, discharge summaries, and any follow-up appointments completed.

Medication reconciliation: review the furosemide 20 mg start on 2026-10-13 (indication lower-extremity edema and weight gain) for prescriber, monitoring plan, and any follow-up labs (electrolytes, renal function) ordered and completed.

Medication starts and stops beyond furosemide: confirm metoprolol succinate, clopidogrel, simvastatin, and nitroglycerin spray are still active, adherence/refill gaps, and whether nitroglycerin was used in the window (chest pain episodes).
Weight trend: obtain serial weights in the window, compare to baseline, and flag gain pattern relevant to the edema/weight gain noted at diuretic start.
Edema and cardiopulmonary symptoms: document lower-extremity edema grade, dyspnea, orthopnea, chest pain, and palpitations since last review, and whether these were escalated.
Blood pressure and heart rate: trend readings in the window, including any low readings or symptomatic hypotension, and resting HR on beta-blocker.
Ischemic heart disease and lipid follow-up: check whether lipid panel and cardiology follow-up are current and any care-plan items due by 2026-11-30.
Function and ADLs/IADLs: compare current ADL and IADL status with prior review, including knee osteoarthritis pain and mobility aids; check for decline.
Cognition, mood, and attendance: screen for any change in cognition or mood, note missed PACE center days or appointments, and check social engagement.

Caregiver and home situation: confirm caregiver availability, any change in living situation, and safety at home; note the allergy profile (tree nut anaphylaxis) is current in meal and medication planning.
Care-plan items due: list goals, assessments, and reassessments with due dates falling in or just after the window and flag any overdue items for IDT discussion.
